title: Impact of Brief Daily Functional Resistance Training on Lower Extremity Physical Performance
official: Impact of Brief Daily Functional Resistance Training on Lower Extremity Physical Performance
summary: In this study, we will randomly assign 360 older adults to 12 months of 5 minutes per day of functional resistance training or to a delayed treatment control condition, and measure the impact of the training on measures of lower extremity performance and walking ability.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Self-reported difficulty or inability to walk ¼ mile

Exclusion Criteria:

* Chest pain on the PAR-Q
